notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Repeat.
